line: Create a bright suburban listing poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "NORTHGATE REALTY" Scene: a two storey suburban family house with pale siding and a dark shingle roof stands behind a mown front lawn, a paved driveway curving to the garage on the right. Warm late afternoon sun rakes across the facade, a deep blue sky above, a red leaved maple beside the covered porch and flower beds along the path. Text layout: a wide deep navy blue band across the upper third carries "JUST LISTED" in bold spaced caps. Under the house a white panel holds "Maple Ridge Family Home" in large type with "42 Larkspur Lane, Brookfield" beneath it in a lighter weight, then a thin divider and the specification row "4 BED - 2 BATH - 210 SQM". The price "489,000" sits bottom left, "BOOK A VIEWING" bottom right inside a filled button shape. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Rich colour architectural photography in golden light, saturated blue sky and green lawn, warm shadows, high contrast, crisp readable typography. two storey white suburban family house with a dark roof and a green front lawn

Create a golden hour villa listing poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "AURELIA ESTATES" Scene: a flat roofed modern villa of pale travertine and dark timber sits behind a long rectangular pool that mirrors the facade. Floor to ceiling glass glows warm from inside, low sun rakes across the terrace, palms and clipped hedges frame the plot. Text layout: "FOR SALE" runs vertically down the left edge in thin spaced caps. The headline "Villa Solano" sits across the lower third in a light serif, "Cypress Hills" under it in small caps. A full width bar at the very bottom in warm sand beige holds "5 BED - 4 BATH - 420 SQM" on the left and "2,150,000" on the right. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Architectural photography at golden hour, warm interior glow, mirror still water, crisp readable typography. modern flat roofed villa with a long pool reflecting the lit glass facade at sunset

Create a sold announcement poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "HOLLOWAY AND PARK" Scene: a brick end of terrace house with white window frames, photographed straight on from the pavement in warm low evening sun that makes the brick glow orange. A blank yard sign stands in the small front garden. Deep green hedges to both sides, a blue sky, flowering pots on the step. Text layout: the word "SOLD" is stamped diagonally across the middle of the image in heavy outlined caps, bright signal red, slightly transparent so the house shows through. A solid footer holds "ANOTHER HAPPY FAMILY MOVED IN" in medium caps, "Fernbrook Road" beneath it, and on the right "LISTED BY CLARA VOSS". A short line "IN 19 DAYS" sits above the stamp in small letters. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Warm evening photography, glowing brick, saturated greens, long shadows, strong colour, crisp readable typography. red brick end of terrace house with white windows and a blank yard sign in the garden

Create an open house invitation poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "BELLMONT HOMES" Scene: a narrow three storey townhouse of warm sandstone with black railings, steps up to a painted front door, window boxes in bloom. Shot from across the street in even daylight, neighbouring houses softly out of focus on both sides. Text layout: a tall panel over the lower half in deep forest green carries "OPEN HOUSE" in wide caps at the top, then the date "SATURDAY 14 JUNE" very large, the time "11 AM - 3 PM" directly beneath in lighter weight. A thin rule, then "8 Sable Row" and "3 BED - 2 BATH" on one row. The wordmark "BELLMONT HOMES" sits centred at the very bottom. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Even daylight street photography, shallow depth of field, crisp readable typography. narrow three storey townhouse with a painted front door and flowering window boxes

Create a dark luxury penthouse expose, vertical 4:5. Agency: "MERIDIAN PRIVATE" Scene: a penthouse terrace at blue hour, seen from inside through open sliding glass. Low lounge furniture, a lit fire bowl, and beyond the glass balustrade a dense city skyline of scattered lights. Deep shadows, restrained warm pools of light, honed dark stone underfoot. Text layout: everything is set in a fine serif directly on the dark image, no panels. "PRIVATE COLLECTION" sits at the top centre in tiny spaced caps, the headline "The Ardent Penthouse" fills the middle in large light serif with "Harbour District" in italic beneath. A single hairline rule near the bottom separates "3 BED - 3 BATH - 310 SQM" from "PRICE ON REQUEST", the wordmark "MERIDIAN PRIVATE" centred below both. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings or landmarks. Moody architectural interior photography at dusk, low key lighting, crisp readable typography. penthouse terrace with lounge seating and a fire bowl overlooking a lit city skyline at dusk

Create a new development launch poster, vertical 4:5. Developer: "KESTREL DEVELOPMENTS" Scene: an architectural visualisation of a four storey apartment block with pale brick and bronze metalwork, staggered balconies planted with greenery, a glazed ground floor. Deep blue sky with light cloud, a landscaped path with flowering beds in front, a few figures walking, rendered in warm late afternoon sun with long shadows. Text layout: "NOW SELLING OFF PLAN" appears top left in small spaced caps. The project name "Alder Court Residences" is set large across the lower image with "Westhaven Quarter" under it. A row of three short blocks sits at the very bottom on a muted terracotta strip: "1 - 3 BED APARTMENTS", "READY SPRING 2027" and "RESERVE NOW", separated by thin vertical rules. Invented developer only, no real companies, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Architectural visualisation in warm golden light, saturated sky and planting, strong colour contrast, crisp readable typography. rendered four storey apartment block with planted balconies and a landscaped path

Create a friendly estate agency advert, vertical 4:5. Agency: "HEARTHSTONE REALTY" Scene: a welcoming detached house with cream render and a slate roof, warm light in the windows, the front door open a crack, potted plants on the steps. Strong golden hour sun, a deep blue sky, a red bicycle leaning by the path and a border of bright flowers. Text layout: the headline "FIND YOUR DREAM HOME" spans the top across two lines in a rounded bold face, "We handle the search, the paperwork and the keys" under it in a lighter weight. The lower third is a solid soft olive green block carrying the service line "BUYING - SELLING - VALUATION" in spaced caps. Beneath it a single contact strip reads "hearthstone-realty.example", with the wordmark "HEARTHSTONE REALTY" on the opposite side. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Warm lifestyle architectural photography in rich golden hour light, saturated colour, glowing windows, crisp readable typography. welcoming detached house with warm lit windows and potted plants on the front steps

Create a price reduction poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "CIVIC AND CO" Scene: a bright city apartment living room, tall windows with sheer curtains, pale oak floor, a low sofa and a single plant. Warm afternoon sun floods in from the left and lays bright patches across the floor, a large plant in the corner and leafy rooftops in full colour through the glass. Text layout: a bold tag in bright amber yellow sits at an angle in the top right corner reading "PRICE DROP". Across the bottom a white panel shows the old price "349,000" struck through in grey and directly beside it the new price "319,000" in large dark type. Under the prices a single row gives "Quill Street, Midtown" and "2 BED - 1 BATH - 78 SQM". Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Sunlit interior photography, warm oak tones against white walls, strong light patches, rich colour, crisp readable typography. bright empty apartment living room with tall windows, pale oak floor and a low sofa

Create a quiet teaser poster for an upcoming listing, vertical 4:5. Agency: "WREN AND FIELD" Scene: a stone cottage with a mossy slate roof and a tall chimney sits at the end of a gravel track, half wrapped in early morning mist. Bare hedgerows, dew on the grass, muted colours, a single lit window. The house reads small in the frame with a lot of pale sky above it. Text layout: "COMING SOON" is set in wide letter spaced caps across the centre of the mist, thin and pale. Near the bottom, left aligned, "Thornmere Cottage" in a medium serif with "Hollow Vale" underneath. On the right edge of the same line sits "ON THE MARKET 3 MARCH". The wordmark "WREN AND FIELD" stands alone in the top left corner. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Atmospheric landscape photography, heavy morning mist, muted palette, crisp readable typography. stone cottage at the end of a gravel track in early morning mist with one lit window

Create a sober commercial letting poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "AXFORD COMMERCIAL" Scene: an empty open plan office floor, exposed concrete ceiling with visible services, polished screed underfoot, a continuous window band along one wall showing a quiet industrial street. Low afternoon sun pours through the window band and throws long bright bars across the floor, a blue sky and green street trees outside, structural columns receding into depth. Text layout: a narrow header bar in deep slate grey holds "OFFICE SPACE TO LET" on the left and "AXFORD COMMERCIAL" on the right. The lower third sits on a white ground: "The Foundry Floor 3" in a tight grotesque with "Ironworks Quarter" beneath. Below that a two column data block pairs "640 SQM OPEN PLAN" with "AVAILABLE IMMEDIATELY", and a last line reads "ARRANGE AN INSPECTION". Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Wide angle interior photography in warm raking sunlight, strong light and shadow, warm concrete against a blue sky, crisp readable typography. empty open plan office floor with exposed concrete ceiling and a long window band

Create an aerial land sale poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "TERRA LOTS" Scene: a drone view straight down over a rectangular building plot of open meadow, bordered by a low hedgerow and a line of poplars. A dirt access track runs to one corner, neighbouring fields in different greens around it. Late golden hour light, long tree shadows across the grass, the meadow in vivid greens with wildflowers, neighbouring fields in gold and deep green. Text layout: a thin white outline traces the plot boundary in the image with small corner markers. The upper left corner holds "LAND FOR SALE" in a tight box. A wide footer on deep moss green carries "Cedar Field Plot 7" in bold caps, and under it three short entries side by side: "1,250 SQM", "RESIDENTIAL ZONING" and "178,000". The wordmark "TERRA LOTS" sits in the top right. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing places. Aerial drone photography, top down perspective, warm low sun, saturated greens and golds, crisp readable typography. aerial top down view of an empty rectangular meadow plot with a dirt access track

Create a compact rental advert, vertical 4:5. Agency: "KEYSTONE LETTINGS" Scene: a small studio apartment in warm evening light, a made bed against one wall, a two seat table by the window, a small potted olive tree on the sill. Lamps on and glowing amber, a burning orange sunset over the city outside the glass, a patterned rug and coloured cushions on the bed. Text layout: a rounded card floats over the lower half in off white. On it: "AVAILABLE NOW" as a small pill in warm coral, then the rent "850" very large with "PER MONTH" small beside it, and below a two line block with "Pallett Street, Old Town" and "STUDIO - 34 SQM - FURNISHED". The wordmark "KEYSTONE LETTINGS" sits above the card on the image itself. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Warm interior photography, amber lamp light against a violet and orange sunset, rich saturated colour, crisp readable typography. small tidy studio apartment with a made bed and a window table in warm evening light

Create a four panel interior collage poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "FOUNDRY AND FLOOR" Scene: four equal photographs in a two by two grid with thin white gutters, all from the same exposed brick and black steel loft: the open living area with tall factory windows, the kitchen island, the mezzanine bedroom, the bathroom in dark tile. Warm afternoon sun in every frame, glowing red brick, green plants and deep coloured textiles, consistent rich colour across all four. Text layout: a header strip above the grid carries "The Cordage Loft" on the left and "NEW LISTING" on the right. Each panel has a small caption in its lower left corner. Below the grid a footer in charcoal black holds "2 BED - 2 BATH - 165 SQM" and "612,000" on one line, with the wordmark "FOUNDRY AND FLOOR" and "Millgate" on the line beneath. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Consistent interior photography in warm sunlight, saturated brick and foliage, strong contrast, crisp readable typography. four interior photos of a brick loft: living area, kitchen island, mezzanine bedroom, dark bathroom

Create a status update poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "LARKIN PROPERTY" Scene: a single storey bungalow with a low pitched roof and a carport, a gravel garden with ornamental grasses across the front. Low golden sun from the side sets the grasses alight and throws long shadows over the path, a deep blue sky, flowering shrubs along the front. Calm suburban street, no cars. Text layout: a solid deep plum ribbon crosses the top right corner at forty five degrees carrying "UNDER CONTRACT" in small white caps. The bottom fifth is a plain white band: "OFFER ACCEPTED" in medium caps on the left, "Wexley Close" underneath it, and the wordmark "LARKIN PROPERTY" pushed to the right edge. A small note "BACKUP OFFERS WELCOME" sits directly above the band on the image. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Golden hour architectural photography, glowing grasses, saturated sky, long shadows, crisp readable typography. single storey bungalow with a carport and a low pitched roof in late afternoon sun

Create a discreet luxury sold notice, vertical 4:5. Agency: "HAVERSHAM AND ROWE" Scene: a symmetrical country estate of honey coloured stone with sash windows at the end of a long gravel drive lined with mature trees, photographed from the drive in warm low sun. Lawns to both sides, tall chimneys, no cars and no people. Text layout: a thin gold hairline frame runs inside the poster edge. "JUST SOLD" sits centred at the top in tiny wide caps above a short gold rule. The estate name "Ashcombe House" is set centred in a large serif over the lawn with "The Downs" small beneath. At the bottom, centred and stacked: "SOLD OFF MARKET IN SIX WEEKS" then the wordmark "HAVERSHAM AND ROWE", separated by a second gold rule. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Estate photography in warm low sun, symmetrical composition, crisp readable typography. symmetrical country estate at the end of a tree lined gravel drive in warm low sun

Create a lively open house weekend flyer, vertical 4:5. Agency: "SUNNYVALE PROPERTY" Scene: a semi detached house with pale yellow render and white trim, a wide open front gate and a path of stepping stones. Bright breezy sunshine under a deep blue sky, bright red and yellow balloons tied to the gate post, flower beds either side of the path. Text layout: a large hand drawn style arrow in bright turquoise points from the top left down towards the front door with "OPEN THIS WEEKEND" written along it. Bottom left a stacked schedule: "SAT 22 AND SUN 23" over "10 AM - 4 PM". Bottom right a boxed block with "14 Ridley Avenue" and "3 BED - 1 BATH - GARAGE" beneath each other. The wordmark "SUNNYVALE PROPERTY" runs along the very bottom edge. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Bright saturated daylight photography, strong blue sky, vivid colour, cheerful and lively, crisp readable typography. semi detached house with an open front gate, stepping stone path and balloons on the gate post

Create a coastal listing poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "SALT AND SHORE" Scene: a low timber beach house on stilts sits directly above the sand, a wooden walkway leading down to the water. Sunset behind it, the sea calm and glassy, lanterns and a hanging chair along the deck. Warm backlight, long soft shadows on the beach. Text layout: the headline "WAKE UP TO THE SEA" is set very wide across the sky in thin caps, letters spaced far apart. Underneath, centred, "Driftwood House" in a medium weight with "Fenn Bay" below it. A single line at the bottom holds "4 BED - 3 BATH - DIRECT BEACH ACCESS" left, "1,340,000" right, with the wordmark "SALT AND SHORE" centred between them on a deep sea blue band. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings or coastlines. Warm backlit coastal photography, glassy water, crisp readable typography. low timber beach house on stilts above the sand with a walkway to the sea at sunset

Create a winter chalet listing poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "ALPINE KEY" Scene: a timber and stone chalet half buried in fresh snow, deep eaves loaded with white, every window glowing warm. Snow still falling in fine flakes, steep pine covered slopes rising behind the roofline in the blue dusk. Footprints lead to the door. Text layout: the top left carries the wordmark "ALPINE KEY" and "NEW TO MARKET" stacked in small caps. Across the lower third a translucent dark panel holds "Chalet Silberhorn" in a warm serif, "Vesper Valley" beneath, then a three part row: "5 BED - 3 BATH - 280 SQM", "SKI IN SKI OUT" and "1,890,000" divided by dots. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings or resorts. Winter dusk photography, falling snow, warm window glow against blue light, crisp readable typography. timber and stone chalet in deep fresh snow with warm glowing windows at blue dusk

Create a factual investment poster, vertical 4:5. Investment agency: "VANTAGE CAPITAL PROPERTY" Scene: a well kept four storey apartment building seen from the opposite pavement, light grey render with dark window frames, uniform balconies, ground floor entrance with a canopy. Clear afternoon sun on the facade under a deep blue sky, a row of green street trees casting shadows across the pavement. Text layout: the upper edge holds "INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY" in a slim outlined box. The bottom half sits on a solid dark ink blue ground and is organised as a data table: three rows, each with a label on the left and a figure on the right, reading "GROSS YIELD 6.2 PERCENT", "12 UNITS - FULLY LET" and "2,400,000". Above the table "Bramble Court" with "Eastfield" beside it, below it the wordmark "VANTAGE CAPITAL PROPERTY". Invented agency only, no real companies, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Sunlit architectural photography, blue sky, warm facade and green foliage, clean strong colour, crisp readable typography. four storey apartment building with uniform balconies in clear afternoon sun

Create an estate agent introduction card, vertical 4:5. Agency: "MARLOWE HOMES" Scene: a friendly professional in a navy blazer over a white shirt stands turned slightly to camera against a plain studio backdrop, arms relaxed, warm confident expression. Soft even studio light, the figure cropped from the knees up and placed to the right of the frame. Text layout: the left third is a solid deep burgundy column. On it, stacked from the top: the wordmark "MARLOWE HOMES", then the name "RENA OKAFOR" in large type, "SENIOR SALES AGENT" beneath in small caps, a short rule, and "City apartments and first homes". At the very bottom of the column sits "marlowe-homes.example". A short greeting "LET US FIND IT TOGETHER" runs across the backdrop beside the head. Invented agency and invented person, no real brokerages and no real people. Clean studio portrait photography, soft even light, crisp readable typography. friendly estate agent in a navy blazer standing against a plain studio backdrop

Create a warm congratulations post, vertical 4:5. Agency: "OPEN DOOR REALTY" Scene: two hands meet in the centre of the frame as a set of house keys on a small wooden house shaped keyring is passed over. Behind them, thrown out of focus, the front of a newly bought home in soft afternoon light. Shallow depth of field, the keys sharp and catching the sun. Text layout: "CONGRATULATIONS" arcs across the top in a friendly rounded face. Below the hands sits a small pill in soft mustard reading "KEYS HANDED OVER". The bottom band, plain and light, carries "Wishing you many happy years in your new home" over two centred lines and the wordmark "OPEN DOOR REALTY" underneath, with "Brindle Park" in the corner. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Warm shallow depth of field lifestyle photography, afternoon light, crisp readable typography. two hands passing over a set of house keys in front of a blurred home

Create an interior feature poster for a kitchen, vertical 4:5. Agency: "STILL AND CO PROPERTY" Scene: a bright fitted kitchen shot from the doorway, a broad island in pale veined marble at the centre, handleless cabinets along the back wall, a window above the sink. Fruit in a shallow bowl, everything else cleared. Even daylight, no harsh reflections. Text layout: a slim vertical strip down the right edge in warm clay carries "INSIDE THE HOME" rotated ninety degrees. Bottom left, over the image, "A KITCHEN BUILT FOR GATHERING" sits in two lines of tight caps with "Stone island - induction hob - walk in pantry" underneath in a lighter weight. A single closing line at the very bottom pairs "Fallow House" with the wordmark "STILL AND CO PROPERTY". Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real brands and no recognisable existing buildings. Interior real estate photography, even daylight, straight lines, crisp readable typography. bright fitted kitchen with a broad stone island and handleless cabinets

Create a soft interior poster for a bedroom, vertical 4:5. Agency: "LUMEN HOMES" Scene: a master bedroom in early morning light, linen bedding in oatmeal and soft white, sheer curtains lifting slightly at a tall window, a bench at the foot of the bed. A door stands open to an ensuite in the background. Gentle shadows, dust in the light beam. Text layout: no panels at all, type sits directly on the image. "ROOM OF THE WEEK" runs small along the top edge next to the wordmark "LUMEN HOMES". The caption "Mornings start slower in a room like this" is set low on the left in a light serif over two lines. Bottom right, aligned to the same baseline, "MASTER SUITE - 32 SQM - ENSUITE" and beneath it "Halden Gardens" in tiny caps. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Soft morning interior photography, sheer light, muted palette, crisp readable typography. master bedroom with linen bedding and sheer curtains in soft morning light

Create an outdoor living poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "GREENWAY AND SONS" Scene: a paved terrace opening onto a landscaped garden on a summer afternoon. A long table set for a meal under a pergola hung with wisteria, deep borders of grasses and shrubs, a lawn running back to a hedge. Dappled light, glasses catching the sun, no people in frame. Text layout: the headline "Summer belongs outside" sits across the sky in a relaxed italic. A narrow horizontal strip in soft sage crosses the middle of the image carrying "SOUTH FACING GARDEN - 340 SQM PLOT" in small spaced caps. The lower left corner stacks "Willowmead", "Ellery Lane" and "725,000"; the wordmark "GREENWAY AND SONS" sits opposite in the lower right. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing gardens. Summer garden photography, dappled light, rich greens, crisp readable typography. paved terrace with a long set table opening onto a landscaped summer garden

Create a top floor apartment listing, vertical 4:5. Agency: "ROOFLINE CITY" Scene: a converted attic apartment with white sloped ceilings and two large skylights letting in hard afternoon sun. Exposed roof beams painted white, wide pale oak boards underfoot, a reading chair beneath the lower slope. Bright, airy, sharp shafts of light across the floor. Text layout: a bold rule frames the poster on three sides in strong cobalt blue, open at the top. The status "TOP FLOOR - FOR SALE" is centred in the gap of that frame at the top. Low on the image, right aligned, "The Skylight Flat" over "Verity Street". The bottom rule of the frame is interrupted by a small box holding "2 BED - 1 BATH - 96 SQM" and "398,000" side by side, and the wordmark "ROOFLINE CITY" sits just above it. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Bright interior photography, hard skylight beams, white walls, crisp readable typography. converted attic apartment with white sloped ceilings and two large skylights

Create a sustainable home poster, vertical 4:5. Developer: "ROOTED BUILD" Scene: a two storey timber clad house with a solar panelled roof stands on a green plot, a wildflower strip and young birches in front of it. Large triple glazed windows, a rainwater tank at the gable end. Clear bright daylight, deep blue sky, everything crisp and new. Text layout: a circular badge in fresh leaf green sits top right holding "ENERGY CLASS A" over two lines. The headline "A HOME THAT COSTS THE EARTH LESS" runs along the bottom of the sky in medium caps. A light footer holds three efficiency entries in a row, "HEATING 22 KWH PER SQM", "SOLAR ROOF - HEAT PUMP" and "545,000", with the wordmark "ROOTED BUILD" and "Sorrel Meadow" on a thin line beneath them. Invented developer only, no real companies, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Bright architectural photography, clear sky, natural timber tones, crisp readable typography. two storey timber clad house with solar panels on the roof and large windows

Create an elegant period property expose, vertical 4:5. Agency: "CAVENDISH ROW" Scene: a stucco townhouse facade at dusk, tall sash windows lit from within, a stone staircase to a panelled door flanked by two black carriage lamps. Wrought iron railings, a paved street still wet from rain reflecting the lights. Deep blue sky above the roofline. Text layout: the upper third stays clear of the building and holds, centred, the wordmark "CAVENDISH ROW" above a fine rule with "A PERIOD HOUSE OF RARE PROPORTION" beneath it. Across the bottom a dark translucent band carries "Number Eleven, Ottley Square" in a high contrast serif on the left, and on the right a stacked pair of "BUILT 1878 - RESTORED 2021" and "6 BED - 4 BATH - 390 SQM". The price "3,100,000" sits alone under the band. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Evening architectural photography, wet reflective street, warm window light, crisp readable typography. lit stucco townhouse facade at dusk with a stone staircase and iron railings

Create a social promo for a virtual property tour, vertical 4:5. Agency: "CLARIT HOMES" Scene: the view from a hallway into a bright open living room, a staircase rising on one side, a tall mirror and a vase of branches catching the light. The framing is slightly wide and low as if paused mid walkthrough. Warm afternoon sun falls in bright patches across the floor, green plants and a deep coloured rug lift the room. Text layout: "WALK THROUGH IT TONIGHT" is set across the upper image in two short lines of bold caps over a soft warm amber gradient. Under it, small and centred, "FULL TOUR - 3 MINUTES". The bottom edge carries a full width bar with the wordmark "CLARIT HOMES" on the left, "Peveril House" in the middle and "LINK IN BIO" on the right. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Interior walkthrough photography, wide framing, warm sunlight and saturated colour, crisp readable typography. view from a hallway into a bright open living room with a staircase to one side

Create a calm financing service poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "ANCHOR HOME FINANCE" Scene: a quiet desk seen from above at a slight angle: a laptop turned away, a folder of papers, a pair of reading glasses, a cup of black coffee and a small architectural model of a house at the corner. Soft daylight from a window on the left, warm wood surface. Text layout: the top half stays mostly empty apart from "Know what you can borrow before you fall in love" in a calm medium serif over two lines, with "Independent mortgage advice, free first appointment" small underneath. The lower half is a solid deep teal panel carrying three numbered steps as short lines under each other: "1 TALK - 2 COMPARE - 3 SIGN". Under the steps a divider, then "BOOK A CALL" on the left and the wordmark "ANCHOR HOME FINANCE" on the right. Invented agency only, no real companies, no real rates and no recognisable brands. Overhead desk photography, soft window light, warm wood tones, crisp readable typography. wooden desk from above with a laptop, folder, glasses and a small model house

Create a seller lead poster, vertical 4:5. Agency: "TRUE NORTH REALTY" Scene: a modest family house photographed from a low angle across the front lawn so the roofline sits against a clean sky. grey siding with a white porch, a mown lawn, a mailbox at the kerb. Warm evening sun on the siding under a deep blue sky, a vivid green lawn and a flowering shrub by the porch. Text layout: the question "WHAT IS YOUR HOME WORTH TODAY" is set very large across the sky in a heavy face, breaking over three lines. A tilted sticker in bright lime sits over the lower left corner of the house reading "FREE VALUATION". At the very bottom a plain strip holds "A written estimate within 48 hours" on the left and "REQUEST YOURS" on the right, with the wordmark "TRUE NORTH REALTY" centred above the strip. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings. Golden hour exterior photography, low angle, saturated blue sky and green lawn, crisp readable typography. modest family house from a low angle across the lawn against a clean sky

Create a blue hour waterfront listing, vertical 4:5. Agency: "QUAYSIDE LIVING" Scene: a corner balcony of a modern condominium juts out over still water at blue hour, glass balustrade, two chairs and a low table. The building lights and a line of moored sailing boats lay long reflections across the surface below. Cool blue sky with a last warm band at the horizon. Text layout: the wordmark "QUAYSIDE LIVING" sits alone at the top centre in fine caps. Low over the water "JUST LISTED" is set in a thin outlined box on the left. The bottom is a single dark bar split into three cells by hairlines: "Pier House 12B", "2 BED - 2 BATH - 118 SQM" and "865,000", with "North Basin" running underneath the bar in small letters. Invented agency only, no real brokerages, no real addresses and no recognisable existing buildings or harbours.
